title: Applying Half-Frame Photography
slide_intent: Give image and words separate room because an appetizing photograph should not undermine the clarity of the message.
strategic_value: An edge-to-edge food photograph paired with a stable type panel can combine appetite and consistent information hierarchy for Burger King.
demonstration: A cropped photograph of hands holding a burger occupies the left half of a landscape composition; the gridded cream text panel sits at right.
practical_value: Use a half-frame image when dimensions allow and retain the proper separation from the text frame.

content_islands.name: Half-frame instruction
content_islands.spec: Place the guidance in the left page column.

content_islands.name: Photographic half
content_islands.spec: Fill the left side of the large example with the person holding a burger.

content_islands.name: Type half
content_islands.spec: Retain headline, subhead, body and bottom-right logo within the cream grid at right.

ingredient.name: Half-frame photography
ingredient.role: Combine visual appetite with a readable information area.
ingredient.application: Add edge-to-edge photography where the application dimensions permit; preserve the proper margin between photo and text frame.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. This example uses a left/right division rather than requiring that orientation universally.

reference_purposes.Application: The example pairs edge-to-edge photography with the established type layout.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The text makes image use conditional on dimensions and requires the proper margin between photograph and text frame.
